chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ibn Ibraham from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said regarding a man who divorces his wife: He has the right to reconcile (with her). And he said: He does not divorce her with the third divorce until he has had sexual intercourse with her.

key_terms.التَّطْلِيقَةَ الْأُخْرَى: the other divorce (referring to the third/irrevocable one)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a third, irrevocable divorce in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the mechanism of 'Taliq al-'Iddah' (divorce during the waiting period), establishing that a third, irrevocable divorce requires consummation of the marriage during the preceding revocable divorce's iddah. This ruling is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between a simple revocable divorce and the final divorce that triggers the 'Tahlil' condition (marriage to another man). The requirement ensures the marital bond is fully realized before the final severance, preventing premature irrevocability.
